title: Megurine Luka — Fairy Lantern♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori and Haruka should be at the park by now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait to see what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It'll be my first time at an amusement park too. I'm so excited♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I think that's Minori calling us.
Let's go♪
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No, we should be the ones thanking you. We're happy that you invited us.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We haven't been able to sit still since you two invited us to join you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, Rin in particular...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, wow!
Look at the roller coaster! It's going so fast!
The ferris wheel's really big too!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, they are♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so glad you're enjoying everything! Let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The Ferris wheel was so much fun! I didn't know it could go up so high!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I know! We could see for miles and miles thanks to the great weather too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, next we should go on...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm a little surprised that no one's seemed to have noticed us yet, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing everybody here is too focused on the rides and mascots. They're providing us cover in a way...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One mascot in particular, Phenny, is really popular and... *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's Phenny...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The person in the costume over there?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It's looks so cute and fluffy! Is it supposed to be a penguin?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, if you look more closely, you'll see that he's a phoenix. He only looks that way because he's sort of supposed to be a baby bird.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hm? You like him very much, don't you, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Um, actually...
I like him because he sort of looks like a penguin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some people even call him Phenny Penguin!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? You seem to know quite a lot yourself, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's this girl in my class that really loves PXL and taught me all about it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, no. Shiho loves Phenny too, but it's this other girl that I'm really close with...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Did you see that? Everyone cheered when Phenny flapped his wings just now.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Someone may've said the magic words Otori was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Magic words?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Apparently, if you say the magic words, Phenny will do cute things for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see. It's his form of fan service...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That means Phenny is this amusement park's idol, no?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An idol...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just thinking that we could learn a few things from Phenny in term of how to treat our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask him to fly for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I wanna see that too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We'll be hiding in your pocket in the meantime.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry, we'll try to be quick!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I know we're here to have fun, but stopping Haruka may be a bit difficult now...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, however...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm just glad that Minori's genuinely been having fun today too.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <When she was practicing for their joint stream, she really didn't seem like herself...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I remember...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And do you remember how she kept practicing even after their show was over?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was so worried about which straw would end up breaking the camel's back but...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I feel so relieved after seeing her laugh and have fun like this.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I see.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is this why you wanted to come here today? You have plans to go hiking in the mountains too, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I did, but I was also very interested in seeing an amusement park.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I can go off to see how Airi and the others are doing without much worry now.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right. Are you sure you still have time to go see them, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I think so. They said that they'll tell me when they find a nice view.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That sounds so nice! I hope the four of them have a good time together...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I hope so too♪>
